$comment: ID09042026: ganrad: v3.0.1: This schema defines the attributes for configuring tool retrieval settings
title: RAPID toolRetrieval configuration
description: Per-AI-Application tool retrieval settings. Lives under the AI App configuration as the `toolRetrieval` object. All properties are optional; omitted values fall back to the defaults shown, which match RETRIEVAL_DEFAULTS in lib/toolRetriever.js and DEFAULTS in lib/toolIndexBuilder.js.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, the full tool catalog is sent to the planner (identical behavior to strategy=none).

strategy.description: Scoring strategy. 'lexical' = BM25 only, no embedding call (safe for deployments with no embedding endpoint). 'semantic' = embedding cosine only. 'hybrid' = both, fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion. 'none' = retrieval disabled, full catalog to the planner; use as the A/B control.

topK.description: Maximum number of tools in the shortlist BEFORE server co-inclusion. alwaysInclude tools consume slots from this budget.

minK.description: Floor on shortlist size. Applied after scoreFloor filtering so a narrow query cannot starve the planner. Must be <= topK (enforced at load time, not expressible in JSON Schema).

scoreFloor.description: Minimum fused RRF score for a tool to be shortlisted. RRF scores are 1/(60+rank) summed across scorers, so a single top-ranked hit scores ~0.0164 and rank 20 scores ~0.0125. Set to 0 to disable floor filtering and rely on topK alone.

serverCoInclusion.description: Sibling tools pulled in per MCP server that produced a retrieved hit. Tools on one server are usually used together (lookup -> read -> write). Set to 0 to disable.

coInclusionBudget.description: Global cap on co-included tools across all servers. ADDITIVE to topK: the fused list normally fills topK on a large catalog, so co-inclusion needs its own slots or it never fires. Effective max shortlist size is topK + coInclusionBudget.

candidatePool.description: Depth of each scorer's ranked list before fusion. Should comfortably exceed topK; raising it costs almost nothing and improves fusion quality.

bypassBelowToolCount.description: If the app's catalog has this many tools or fewer, retrieval is skipped entirely and the full catalog goes to the planner. Set to 0 to force retrieval on regardless of catalog size (required when testing a small catalog).

expandFactor.description: Multiplier applied to topK on the empty-plan fallback retry. Bounded by the catalog size.

embeddingDimensions.description: Dimensionality requested from the embedding model at index build time. Ignored when strategy=lexical. Changing this invalidates the embedding cache, because it is part of the cache key.

maxAlwaysInclude.description: Build-time cap on tools marked alwaysInclude across the app's SKILL.md files. Exceeding it throws during index build, preventing authors from silently disabling retrieval.

semanticCache.description: Process-local cache of shortlists keyed by query embedding. Inert when strategy=lexical, because it requires a query vector.

enabled.description: Reuse a previous shortlist when the incoming query embedding is near-identical to a cached one.

threshold.description: Cosine similarity required for a cache hit. Lower values increase hit rate but risk serving a shortlist built for a materially different query.

max.description: Maximum cached entries per cache bucket. Buckets are keyed by app + index version + effective config, so each config variant caches separately.

fallback.description: Behavior when the planner returns no usable steps from the shortlist.

onEmptyPlan.description: 'expand' retries retrieval once with topK * expandFactor and re-plans, trading latency on the rare miss for correctness. 'none' accepts the empty plan.
